evals.prompt: Run the DORA metrics for Example Project.
evals.expected_output: Shows the confirmation table (2 rows: example-frontend and example-backend, main branch, 14-day window), verifies authentication, attempts to run the script and reports the result (or the auth error clearly, without inventing numbers).

evals.prompt: Give me the lead time for Example Project over the last 2 weeks.
evals.expected_output: Interprets 'last 2 weeks' as the default 14-day window (does not ask for another window), follows the same flow (table, auth, run, report) focused on Lead Time.

evals.prompt: Run the DORA metrics for the Delta project.
evals.expected_output: Delta is not in config/proyectos.json. The skill does NOT invent repos or run anyway — it asks for the missing details (repos, type, prod branch) to add it straight to the config, instead of sending the user to edit a separate file. It does not run anything until it has the mapping.

evals.prompt: Add the Omega project to the DORA metrics, it has a single repo: acme/omega-api, prod branch develop.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the repo type (web/mobile/backend) if it wasn't given, builds the JSON entry for config/proyectos.json (repo, tipo, prod_branch=develop, without deploy_source or tag_pattern if no overrides apply), shows it for confirmation before saving, and only then continues with the normal flow (confirmation table, etc.).

evals.prompt: example-frontend doesn't publish Releases, only plain tags vX.Y.Z. Run the metrics anyway.
evals.expected_output: Uses deploy_source=tag (via the --deploy-source override or by updating the config), does not invent non-existent releases nor fail silently.
